name: @voice-kit/talks
description: voice-kit: multi-turn conversations. A talk of turns with roles and times, the turn loop over a grind the app injects (send(request, files) answers), picture turns that are kept and sent only when asked, a store interface with an in-memory store, a Dexie store for the device (talks/dexie), a searchable TalkList (talks/react), and the tutor client: a registry of named facts, commands and places the tutor can ask for, run and open, and the grind side (talks/grind): the instructions part and answer schema fragment an app's grind includes. The core imports nothing: no React, no DOM.
